payload.title: Prioritize nonlinear candidate coverage and selector regret
payload.decision: Supersede the unstarted E010 wide-datum priority with a fresh nonlinear whole-well candidate-bank experiment. Keep H012/T016 queued and preserve its 64-feature ridge only as a comparator. First measure hidden-label candidate-bank oracle coverage, then measure legal visible-prefix selector regret; never deploy oracle routing.
payload.rationale: The full 773-well oracle ladder is 9.0354 for a per-well constant, 6.6972 for a line, and 3.1106 for a smooth nonlinear curve. Datum/line work cannot by itself reach the gold target. Exact HMM, PF, beam, DTW, constrained smooth and jump candidates now provide a falsifiable route to separate generation failure from selection failure.
payload.revisit_trigger: E010 shows the legal candidate-bank oracle remains above 5 or exact nonlinear candidates cannot meet runtime/control requirements.
